name: ekbasis
description: TypeScript client for Ekbasis: ask what an action will do before it runs (typed, calibrated answers in one pass), and check a plan before running it.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('dist/cjs/package.json', JSON.stringify({type: 'commonjs'}))"
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test test/*.test.mjs test/*.test.cjs
